title: Low-rank approximation of non-Hermitian operators from spectral entangling strength
claim: For every 0 < alpha < 1/3, every finite-dimensional complex bipartite operator X and integer D >= 0, min_OSR(Y)<=D ||X-Y||_op <= J_alpha(X)*(D+1)^(-(1/(2*alpha)-3/2)). The rank exponent is optimal.
scope: Existence/rank guarantee; not an efficient optimizer or physical-channel approximation.
review: Sequential internal proof and source review; no independent expert review or formal verification.
priority_limitation: No matching public theorem was located in the checked sources; the unpublished Kim-Kusunoki-Kuwahara follow-up (reference 93) was unavailable, so overlap cannot be excluded.
inherited_content: The non-Hermitian rank-one obstruction at alpha >= 1/3 is prior work.
contributions: The author directed research and manuscript preparation. AI assistance contributed to derivation, source comparison, computation, checking and drafting.
